verification.source: Full release gate on Linux builder containers; no GitHub Actions
steps: Go root/executor/conformance race/vet, Rust fmt/clippy/tests and three DSM targets passed
Python and Node tests including Python 3.8 and Node 18 passed
TypeScript tests, typecheck/build/pack and packed consumer import passed
Three-architecture Linux vet/build and cold-cache executor/lifecycle reproducibility passed
arm64 and armv7 taskscript binaries passed under qemu user emulation; no NAS/kernel certification
Versioned Go modules fetched through remote tags; checksums identify the release source
Tracked Node adapter bytes equal the gated npm App artifact
npmjs versions/latest and npmmirror readback equal the gated SDK/App archives; both mirror sync requests accepted
verification.approvalImpact: All six executor/lifecycle digests match 0.15.2. An unchanged policy adds no administrator reapproval requirement. Upgrades from 0.15.0 retain the one-time approval introduced in 0.15.1.
